name: Jake Bloss
detail: The Blue Jays recalled Bloss from Triple-A Buffalo on Wednesday and placed him on the 60-day injured list while he recovers from a right teres major strain, Arden Zwelling of Sportsnet.ca reports.

name: Addison Barger
detail: Barger is expected to be sidelined six months following surgery Monday to repair his right elbow UCL, Shi Davidi of Sportsnet.ca reports.

name: Jose Berrios
detail: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said that Berrios underwent full Tommy John surgery Wednesday in addition to having a stress fracture repaired, Hazel Mae of Sportsnet reports.

name: Bowden Francis
detail: The Blue Jays placed Francis (elbow) on the 60-day injured list Wednesday.

name: Matt Waldron
detail: The Nationals placed Waldron on the 15-day injured list Tuesday, retroactive to Saturday, with chest inflammation.

name: Drew Millas
detail: Millas will undergo surgery Friday on his fractured left index finger, Spencer Nusbaum of The Athletic reports.

name: PJ Poulin
detail: The Nationals transferred Poulin (forearm) from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Sunday.

name: Mitchell Parker
detail: Parker underwent elbow ligament repair surgery with an internal brace Wednesday, Mark Zuckerman of NatsJournal.com reports.

name: Ken Waldichuk
detail: Waldichuk (elbow) underwent Tommy John surgery and an internal brace procedure April 21 and is hopeful to return to game action at some point early in the 2027 season, Mark Zuckerman of MASNSports.com
